editor_reconstruction_note: Grey rounded card appears at top: tiny and blurred at f10 then full size by f17 reading 'Q. What if you ignored all the rules of car racing and had a contest which was simply to get a human being around a track 200 times as fast as possible. What strategy would win?' with '—Hunter Freyer' below.
Figure and rectangle shift right while a wicker bin of trash with flies and steam wisps enters from lower-left carrying the magazine; figure's free arm moves to the hip (pose change).
In one frame a drawing appears inside the rectangle: a long rocket with grey cockpit blob and a smoke cloud at left, a small figure lying under the rocket holding a stick.
New line types in under the question inside the card: 'Let's' then 'Let's say the racer has to su' and by f256 'Let's say the racer has to survive.' with a red underline drawn beneath it.

Hard cut at f289 to a full-frame red title card: black T-rex silhouette on a broken satellite above white text 'xkcd's what if? THE VIDEO SERIES'; card is unchanged f289-f327; by f337 (14.04s) hard cut to white canvas with a car with a rocket strapped to its roof and a stick figure at right holding a small disc. Exact cut-out frame between f327 and f337 UNRESOLVED.
Red label '1:30:00' with a short pointer line appears above the stick figure at right.
Hard cut to mostly blank white canvas with small drawing of a streamlined race car with big rear wing and exhaust trail labelled 'VOLKSWAGEN ID.R' at upper-left.
Below the car a drawing of an open sled with seat and rocket exhaust plus label ''GEE-WHIZ' ROCKET SLED' appears.
Third item appears at lower-left: dog-headed coaster train on wheels labelled 'SLINKY DOG DASH' above a ground line.
Three curved connector lines from the vehicles to a large circle at right labelled 'POINT OF FAILURE' (curved text) containing a stick figure standing on a small platform appear in one frame.

Vehicle labels disappear and vehicles shift; the stick figure in the circle tilts then collapses into a small blob pressed against the right side of the circle (f681-f703); at f711 hard cut to a grey oval racetrack with labels 'BAD CURVE' x2 and 'LESS BAD CURVE'. Exact cut frame UNRESOLVED.
Red arrow pointing right labelled 'G-FORCE' appears beside the car on the left curve.
Title 'DAYTONA SPEEDWAY (2.5 MILES PER LAP)' appears above the track.
Grey dashed curved outline zones appear around the two curves of the track.
Black hatched scribble streaks appear fanning from the car at the upper-left curve (skid or debris marks).
Framed portrait of a stick figure with label 'RIP' appears at lower-left outside the track.

Hard cut at f948 to blank canvas with a brick pillar and a small squirrel at right; a VW Beetle slides in from the left with speed lines and stops against the pillar by f975 with crumpled front and impact burst.
Car seat with a stick-figure driver in a seat belt appears above the car.
Red arrow pointing left with red label '100 Gs' appears left of the seat.
Small red '1G' with a short up arrow appears above the seat; whole composition sits slightly higher in the frame.
Hard cut to a detailed fighter jet with number '001' on the tail, cloud exhaust at left, and seat with stick-figure pilot above it.
Red label '10 Gs' with right-pointing red arrow appears beside the pilot seat.
Over f1253-f1260 a large stick figure slides in from the left edge while a thick-framed blackboard border appears and the jet scene shrinks into it.
In one frame the jet and pilot drawing becomes much smaller at top and an L-shaped axis pair appears below it; red 10 Gs arrow gone.
Red dashed horizontal line with red label '10 Gs' appears across the top of the axes.
Black curve is drawn on the axes left to right: flat line then a tall narrow spike reaching the red 10 Gs line (f1378-f1383).
Whole board shifts down slightly; a race car with seat and pilot and a second empty axes pair with red dashed 10 Gs line appear to the right of the jet graph.
Curve drawn on second axes: rises to the 10 Gs line, plateau, dip, then second plateau (f1436-f1442).
Hard cut to a lined document page with NASA logo at upper-left and a large marker pen at right; page otherwise blank.
Title text 'ISSUES ON HUMAN ACCELERATION TOLERANCE AFTER LONG-DURATION SPACE FLIGHTS' appears beside logo.
Grey-shaded chart appears with regions 'SEVERE INJURY', 'MODERATE INJURY', 'SAFE', y-axis 'ACCELERATION (Gs)' and time axis from 1 sec to 1 hr.
Red hand-drawn ellipse with red text '3-6 Gs' appears at the right end of the moderate-injury band; page shifted up.
Hard cut to grey oval track with title 'LIMIT: 4 Gs' at top and small car at upper-left curve.
Dashed curve zones appear around both curves.
Label '240mph' with an arrow pointing up to the car appears at lower-left of track.
Equation '200 LAPS × 2.5 MILES/LAP / 240mph =' appears inside the track oval.
Red result '2:05:00' appears beneath the equation.
Black rounded box with white digital text '2:48:55 CURRENT RECORD' appears beneath the red time.
Car, dashed zones, 240mph label, equation, times and the 'LIMIT: 4 Gs' title are not drawn at f1992; only the grey oval track remains. Title is back by f1993. Onset of title return UNRESOLVED.
Faint car appears on the top straight and faint dashed rectangles fade in around the top straight and two bottom straights over f2004-f2009.

A faint 'SPEED' vs 'POSITION' axes with four small bump icons fades in inside the oval; the car moves along the track while a black speed curve is drawn: rise, peak, fall, then two small bumps; two more cars appear at curves by f2181.
Red horizontal line across the graph with red label 'ACCELERATION' and arrow appears.
Hard cut to a stick figure with round head standing on a striped giant planet at lower-left; tiny globe at upper-left.
A vertical line and a roller coaster with a loop and a rocket-like car with exhaust trail appear at right.

Hard cut at 105.25s back to the oval track with ghosted speed graph; car moves around the track with a red arrow that points back along the track then swings around (f2526-f2648) with fading red fan trail; by f2678 (111.58s) hard cut to a single dark-haired stick figure on blank canvas. Exact cut-out frame between f2648 and f2678 UNRESOLVED.
Sequence of red arrows and underlined labels added around the figure: right arrow, 'UPWARD' fading in, 'FORWARD', down arrow, 'DOWNWARD', left arrow, 'BACKWARD' (f2682-f2690).

Grey bullet notes type in under each label, e.g. 'NO BLOOD IN HEAD', 'BAD', '5Gs LIMIT' under UPWARD; 'HARD TO BREATHE', 'FAIRLY BAD', 'EYEBALLS', '8Gs LIMIT' under BACKWARD; 'NOT SO BAD', 'EYEBALLS UNHAPPY', '20Gs(?) LIMIT' under FORWARD; 'WAY TOO MUCH BLOOD IN HEAD', 'VERY BAD' under DOWNWARD.
No visible change in the tile; peak pixel change is minimal (the BACKWARD strike-through and 'DISTORT' may be what changed; UNRESOLVED).
Star rating above 'FORWARD' builds from one filled star to four and a half filled stars (f2785-f2789).
Star rating above 'DOWNWARD' appears: one filled star then four empty outline stars (f2875-f2879).
Hard cut to large two-tone grey sphere on a robotic arm base with a stick figure inside and speech bubble 'I DIDN'T SIGN UP FOR THIS!'; dark-haired stick figure standing at right on a floor line.

Hard cut at 129.04s to grey oval track with a small grey sphere capsule with a red arrow moving around it; 'LIMIT: 4 Gs →' at lower-left; '~1:45:0' types at right then '~1:45:00'; by f3214 (133.92s) hard cut to a podium scene.
A sedan appears on podium block 2 and another car on block 3 beside the sphere.
Times '2:48:55' under 2 and '2:50:12' under 3 appear; composition shifts up.

Hard cut at 138.71s to track with capsule, 'LIMIT: 4 Gs →' and '~1:45:00'; labels get struck through and replaced: '6 Gs' with '~1:20:00', then '10 Gs' with '~1:00:00'; capsule circles with red arrows and blur; at f3547 capsule has speed streaks and faint unreadable text; by f3602 (150.08s) hard cut to a perfluorocarbon sphere. Exact cut frame UNRESOLVED.
Dense red zigzag scribble covers the sphere (complete by f3728).
Hard cut back to the opening composition: question card with 'Let's say the racer has to survive.' above a bin and a stick figure holding paper, view zoomed in.
Red scribble strikes out the line 'Let's say the racer has to survive.' progressively over f3838-f3840; view also shifted.
Hard cut to a rotating-arm machine (pivot post on round base, long arm with black end weights) labelled 'COUNTERBALANCE' with arrow.
Label '"VEHICLE"' with arrow pointing to the right end of the arm appears.
Grey circular track ellipse with label 'TRACK' and arrow appears around the machine base.
Labels disappear and view becomes top-down: grey circle track with a rod arm pivoting at centre with black ends.
The arm spins around the centre with grey motion blur through several quarter turns (f4080-f4173) and settles with small speed arcs at its tip.
Text types in letter by letter at the top: 'S', 'SPEED LI', 'SPEED LIMIT'.
'=' and a square-root sign with overline are added after SPEED LIMIT.
'SPECIFIC STRENGTH' types under the radical: 'SP', 'SPECIFIC ST', then full.
Label 'KEVLAR' with arrow pointing at the arm appears.
Label 'MAX: ~1.5km/s' with a small spark burst on the arm appears.
Circle shifts left by about a fifth of the frame while a stick figure with a pointer line and grey text '805 km / 1.5 km/s =' fades in at right (f4429-f4437).
Result '~0:08:57' appears under the equation with grey '~0:0' and red '8:57'.
Red zigzag scribble covers the stick figure at right.
Red hatched scribble covers the arm and the spark label area.
Hard cut to a close-up horizontal grey cylindrical chute with segment lines across the middle of the canvas.

A black ball bearing rolls across the chute with horizontal blur several times; the text 'SPEED LIMIT = √SPECIFIC STRENGTH' appears above between f4699 and f4719; at the end the ball carries white text 'MAX: ~1.5km/s' with trailing speed lines.
Cracks appear across the ball.
Ball bursts into many black fragments with small debris and burst lines.
Red scribble drawn over the shards.
Equation, shards and scribble disappear; a faceted wedge-shaped diamond capsule with no label appears at the centre of the chute.
Capsule slides back and forth along the chute with blur; at f5157 it has horizontal speed lines.
Small particles or sparks appear behind the capsule.
Flames and smoke clouds trailing the capsule plus label 'DIAMONDS: ACTUALLY FLAMMABLE' with arrow appear.
Flames, smoke and label disappear; rows of flat disc magnets appear above and below the chute; capsule now has a small wheel-like part beneath.
Capsule progressively shrinks to a tiny dot with a thin speed line (f5369-f5441).
Two stick figures (one dark-haired, one bald) appear at lower-right with speech text 'THIS IS CONCERNING'; chute and magnets shift.
Hard cut to a detailed ring drawing (circle with towers, loops and small structures) with no labels.
Title 'LARGE HADRON COLLIDER (26.7 km)' and ring labels 'CMS', 'ALICE', 'LHCb', 'ATLAS' appear.
Two curved arrows with dashed tails appear on each side of the ring.
Label 'SPEED OF LIGHT: ~300,000 km/s' appears at left.
Scene shifts left/up while a stick figure with pointer and text '805 km / 300,000 km/s =' fades in at right (f5758-f5765).
Result '0:00:0.0027' appears under the equation with red digits.
Hard cut to a page with Wikipedia globe logo and 'WIKIPEDIA The Free Encyclopedia', page otherwise empty.
A table of grey lines with racetrack outlines in one column appears (the page extends below frame).
Page shifts right while a small box 'LHC PARTICLE (NOT TO SCALE)' with a star mark slides in from the left edge (f5915-f5922).
Page text and heading fade out while track outlines drift diagonally and arrange into a grey two-row grid of tracks; LHC card stays at left (f5934-f5948).
First grey track is overdrawn in black loops with a particle spark.
Second track traced in black with a connecting line from the first.
Third track traced in black, line connects from the second.
Fourth (curvy) track traced in black.
Next tracks traced in black (small angular track and one upper-right oval); exact count UNRESOLVED.
Another track traced with the particle moving to the upper-right jagged track.
Next lower-right tracks traced in black.
Final visible track traced at right edge.
Label '805 km × 850 / 300,000 km/s =' with an arrow and result '0:00:02.28' appears at lower-right.
Left column of framed thumbnails appears (car with rocket, jet, Slinky Dog Dash coaster) with small grey loop shapes to the right of each; scene shifts.
Tiny marks appear on the small loops next to each thumbnail; extremely small change.
Hard cut to red end card with T-rex satellite silhouette, credits text list at right, 'GET THE BOOKS: xkcd.com/books' and four book covers.
